title: Even moments of an affine uniform sign
statement: For every nonnegative integer $r$ and real number $c$, the uniform expectation over $s\in\{\pm1\}$ of $(1+c s)^{2r}$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{r}\binom{2r}{2j}c^{2j}$.
